formation_history: 2014-01-01 through 2020-12-31 signal charts and their consumed development outcomes
scientific_note: The chart review found substantial winner/loser overlap in stock-only candle shape, opening gap, turnover multiple and prior return. The only retained incremental hypothesis is a causal market-state branch. This is a chart-derived development rule, not independent confirmation.
plain_language_rules: The stock has fallen at least 10% over the prior 20 completed sessions.
On the signal session it undercuts the prior five-session low, trades at least its prior-20-session average turnover, then closes above the prior session high and in the top 30% of its own range.
The signal session is PIT-valid, fully tradable, non-ST, in one valid corporate-action coordinate lineage, and does not close at the legal upper limit.
The first qualifying event per stock is used and another event requires more than 20 market-session indices.
Admit the signal only when the signal-close market state is either positive 60-session trend, prior-five-session systemic capitulation, or same-session broad recovery.

market_state.availability: All components are computed after the signal-session close from that close and earlier completed sessions only. State is frozen at decision_at and cannot change using later data.
market_state.cross_section: All symbols on that trade date satisfying hard_valid, history_valid, current_valid, current_day_data_tradable, market_rule_valid, corporate_action_valid, not corporate_action_blocking, and not is_st.
market_state.positive_60_session_trend: Cross-sectional median of registered ret60 is strictly greater than 0.
market_state.prior_five_session_systemic_capitulation: Cross-sectional median of each eligible symbol's coordinate return from six sessions before the signal to the session immediately before the signal is <= -5%; five-session history must be contiguous in market-session index and remain in one coordinate lineage.
market_state.same_session_broad_recovery: At least 90% of the eligible signal-date cross-section has registered step_return > 0.

threshold_rationale.zero_trend_boundary: Economically neutral boundary, not a fitted percentile.
threshold_rationale.minus_five_percent_prior_five_sessions: Predeclared round systemic-stress magnitude, not selected from a threshold grid.
threshold_rationale.ninety_percent_positive_fraction: Predeclared extreme breadth boundary for a market-wide recovery, not a fitted percentile.

execution_unchanged: First legal executable open strictly after the signal and no later than the third subsequent market session; +10% target from T+1; H20 next legal sellable open; 40 bps round-trip cost; no stop.
prohibited_interpretations: No future return, future extrema, future breadth, or later market state enters admission.
No full-sample percentile or retrospectively normalized state threshold.
No alternative threshold is authorized after reading 2021 or challenge outcomes.
